exposure: trial of labor (TOL) vs no TOL
cohort: 90,000 women giving birth to twin gestations in the United States (2012-2014) with a cephalic presenting twin and no prior cesarean delivery
finding: Only a minority (39.3%) of women with twin gestations eligible for a vaginal delivery underwent a trial of labor, with older maternal age, Hispanic or Asian race/ethnicity, nulliparity, obesity, and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy being associated with decreased odds of TOL.
mod_finding: This study found that among women with twin pregnancies who were eligible for a vaginal delivery, a minority attempted a trial of labor, with older maternal age, Asian or Hispanic ethnicity, nulliparity, and obesity being associated with lower likelihood of attempting.
